accepted_findings: the v1 oracle assigned executable_role_count from total signed role count instead of measuring each role
the resulting A3 verdict was accidentally correct for the current seven exe paths but not falsifiable under a future non-PE signed role
the generator and schema version did not reflect the revised predicate contract
remediation: v2 derives executable from each signed path extension
v2 computes A3 and C1 from the measured executable subset
v2 accepts parseable cardinality drift and emits FALSE instead of failing before the predicate
the verifier independently recomputes per-role executable status and includes a dedicated tamper self-test
proof_ceiling: Read-only audit of the v1 oracle. The v2 remediation requires its own current verifier and independent audit.
